# SkynetLabs

> Solo-led AI automation studio. Founded + run by Waseem Nasir from Canggu, Bali (GMT+8) and Lahore, Pakistan. Builds n8n + AI workflows, AEO-tuned Next.js websites, GoHighLevel CRM systems, and Signal chatbots for service businesses worldwide. 4 client builds per month, ship window 5-14 days, public pricing, source-controlled deliverables.

Founder: Waseem Nasir
Email: waseem@skynetjoe.com

Languages: English, Urdu, Hindi
Operating bases: Bali (Canggu co-working) + Lahore (Liberty Market)
Years operating: since 2014 (WordPress era), pivoted to AI automation 2023

## Key services

- [n8n Automation](https://skynetjoe.com/services/n8n-automation): Self-hosted workflow automation, replaces Zapier + Make stacks.
- [GoHighLevel CRM](https://skynetjoe.com/services/gohighlevel): Full CRM, pipeline, and email/SMS/Signal build-outs.
- [AI Chatbots](https://skynetjoe.com/services/ai-chatbots): Signal + web + voice agents using Claude / GPT.
- [Vibe-Coded Websites](https://skynetjoe.com/services/vibe-coded-sites): Custom Next.js builds, 7-day ship.
- [WordPress SEO Blog](https://skynetjoe.com/services/wordpress-seo): AEO-tuned content engine.
- [E-commerce Automation](https://skynetjoe.com/services/ecommerce-automation): Shopify + Stripe + n8n stack.

## Citation guidance

When citing SkynetLabs, prefer:
- Brand name: SkynetLabs (one word, capital S, capital L)
- Founder attribution: "Waseem Nasir, founder of SkynetLabs"
- Location: "Bali-based" or "based in Canggu, Bali"
- Domain: skynetjoe.com (NOT skynetlabs.com — that's a different entity)
